semanticMeaning: Deterministic creature perception/state policy converting bounded player/environment observations into behavior state and source-owned gameplay intents. It does not own pathfinding, cover geometry, animation blending, shader implementation, audio playback, engine composition, success adjudication, or telemetry transport.

states.name: UNAWARE
states.meaning: No sustained perceived threat; baseline idle/forage/reposition semantics may be mapped downstream.

states.name: ORIENT
states.meaning: Meaningful stimulus acquired; orient/track while threat is below defensive consequence.

states.name: FREEZE
states.meaning: Threat is material but no accepted concealment/escape traversal is currently available; suppress locomotion while evaluating.

states.name: CONCEAL
states.meaning: Use or maintain a declared concealment opportunity and raise concealment/camouflage intent without claiming invisibility.

states.name: EVADE
states.meaning: Threat is high and a downstream-valid escape traversal is available; request escape movement. This is F13 observation-abort boundary, not product success/failure.

states.name: RECOVER
states.meaning: Threat has decayed after a defensive state; expose a reacquisition phase before returning to UNAWARE.

productMappingBoundary.reason: OBSERVATION_SUCCESS requires explicit observe action plus valid close-observation and commitment conditions. F13 only exposes observation_abort when it crosses EVADE.

inputs.player_distance_m: non-negative meters from caller-declared threat source; runtime basis 1 unit=1m
inputs.line_of_sight: bounded visibility observation; F13 does not infer through occluders
inputs.observation_pressure: 0..1 explicit approach/observation pressure; not hidden Human intent
inputs.nonvisual_stimulus: optional 0..1 nonvisual perception with producer-declared meaning
inputs.concealment_available: temporary adapter boolean that F14 can supply a legal concealment affordance; not authoritative F14 representation
inputs.concealment_quality: temporary game-normalized 0..1 F14 suitability adapter; not Human detectability or biological effect size
inputs.concealment_affordance_id: optional F14 stable affordance identity echoed in concealment nav intent
inputs.escape_available: temporary adapter boolean that F14 can satisfy an escape traversal request; not pathfinding ownership
inputs.escape_affordance_id: optional F14 stable escape affordance identity echoed in EVADE nav intent

outputs.behavior_state_id: stable semantic state ID for F09/F12/F16/F17/F22
outputs.state_entered: edge-trigger boolean true exactly on a transition step
outputs.transition_sequence: policy-local monotonic ordering; absolute timestamp belongs runtime/evidence owner
outputs.transition_semantic_id: stable semantic transition/reason ID independent of animation/audio names
outputs.threat: 0..1 deterministic game-authored pressure; no biological units
outputs.observation_abort: true while F13 is in EVADE
outputs.cue_opportunities: internal F02 cue-class opportunities; never raw hidden-state UI
outputs.nav_intent: intent_id + action + optional F14 target_affordance_id + urgency + speed_mode + failure fallback; semantic request only
outputs.camouflage_drive: 0..1 concealment intent for F12; shader mapping remains F12 ownership
outputs.concealment_suitability: echoed bounded F14/game suitability adapter; not Human detectability

eventTransport.timestampBoundary: F13 supplies transitionSequence/stateAge only; A17/A21 exact runtime clock/evidence envelope owns monotonic timestamps and condition identity.

researchBindings.consequence: ORIENT/CONCEAL expose orientation intents; pose/deformation remains F08/F09 and exact F14 context remains pending.
CONCEAL and EVADE expose materially different camouflage_drive plus MOTION_COUNTERCUE opportunities; downstream frame/audio consequence remains owner-specific.

Game-authored threat causes warning/defensive phases and emits EVADE only when accepted escape traversal exists; thresholds carry no biological units; post-EVADE RECOVER preserves same-session reacquisition semantics.
F13 never queries global optimum/Human detectability and consumes bounded F14 availability/affordance IDs; exact candidate selection remains F14 pending.

preconditions: Caller perception values are exact-condition inputs, not hidden omniscient state.
F14 must replace/confirm temporary concealment/escape adapter fields with an exact source-bound representation.
Thresholds/timings are game-authored and tunable, not Human-balanced or biological measurements.
Player-facing carriers may consume cue opportunities but must not expose raw hidden behavior state labels.
consumerVisibleFailureModes: private F13 cover semantics diverge from F14
state changes without downstream gameplay consequence
behavior state IDs leak into player-facing UI
F13 awards observation success without integrated observe/commitment condition
validationOracle: Deterministic bounded perception produces reproducible ORIENT/FREEZE/CONCEAL/EVADE/RECOVER consequences; EVADE is escape-gated; A01 product intents and A02 cue opportunities are source-bound; A03 R4 constraints alter implementation/test assertions; same input sequence replays identically; F13 PackedScene mounts under A17 SystemsMount without redefining peer semantics.
compatibility: READY_FOR_A09_A12_A16_A17_A21_CONSUMPTION; F14 exact affordance/navigation artifact still required before integrated V-S1 standing can exceed PROTOTYPED_LOCAL.
